scope: YAP-owned repository tooling and workflows; synchronized Press runtime and starter content are excluded

inlineConfiguration.policy: Source comments cannot disable or reconfigure lint rules; a directive beside a real no-undef violation must leave that violation unsuppressed.

noGrowth.policy: Every @eslint/js recommended diagnostic in YAP-owned JavaScript tooling fails CI; synchronized Press runtime assets are outside this repository-owned gate.

prettier.scope: Root quality configuration, .github/workflows YAML, and Prettier-supported files under scripts/

noGrowth.policy: New YAP-owned tooling files must pass Prettier. A changed legacy tooling file must be formatted and removed from the baseline; only exact-content renames may transfer baseline ownership.
